name: solucao-de-promocao
description: Radar de ofertas em tempo real com marketplace adapters, score de promoção e distribuição de oportunidades.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.verify: npm run db:generate && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run build
scripts.docker:build: docker compose build api worker web
